checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/navi-protocol to confirm in-scope Move packages, excluded contracts, severity tiers, and exact submission format.
Clone the official NAVI Sui Move repo listed on the program page and note the exact package IDs and published addresses.
Run agents/external_audit.py on the cloned repo, pointing it at the core lending, collateral, and oracle modules.
Examine the tool report for capability leaks, missing type checks, arithmetic issues, and Move Prover violations.
Manually review admin capability usage, object ownership transfers, and oracle price feed trust assumptions.
Test business logic around liquidation thresholds, flash-loan callbacks, and interest-rate model updates.
Verify any findings are reproducible on a fresh Sui devnet fork using the exact package versions in scope.
Draft the Hackenproof report with clear steps, affected contracts, severity justification, and a minimal PoC transaction.
Verify the current scope, rules, and payout tiers for the NAVI Protocol bug bounty program directly on the Hackenproof website to ensure accuracy and avoid any potential misunderstandings.
Fetch the latest Move smart contract source code from the designated git repository to prepare for analysis.
Run agents/external_audit.py on the fetched Move smart contract code to perform source fetch, Move Prover/sui-prover formal verification where applicable, and frontier-LLM review.
Manually review the audit results against a real vulnerability taxonomy, focusing on access control, oracle trust, reentrancy, and business logic vulnerabilities.
Identify and isolate potential vulnerabilities discovered during the audit and review process for further analysis and confirmation.
Validate the potential vulnerabilities to ensure they are genuine and not false positives, and to determine their severity and impact.
Document the confirmed vulnerabilities in a clear and concise manner, including steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
Prepare a submission for the Hackenproof bug bounty program, including all required information such as vulnerability description, proof-of-concept, and recommended fix.
Submit the report to the NAVI Protocol bug bounty program through the Hackenproof platform, ensuring adherence to the program's rules and guidelines.
